pages: A bell is not for the living. The living have ears and doors and fire. A bell is rung so that the ground remembers it is ground, and that what lies in it lies in it. Ring at dusk, ring when the sky is wrong, ring when you hear the other bell - the one that is a half-note lower and is not ours. Do not ring in the Quiet. In the Quiet nothing should hear where we are.
